description: Force-stops an app (`am force-stop`): its process is killed and its unsaved state is lost, unlike pressing HOME, which leaves it running in the background. Use it for a clean run, then launch_app. Doesn't start anything; stopping the app being profiled ends its SDK link until it is launched again. Fails if the package isn't installed. Device control.

serial.description: adb serial; default: the session device, or the only ready one.

name: stop_app
title: Stop an app
